snippet.title: When Heaven Knocks FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
When Heaven Knocks By Monty Adventure Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

One year prior, the town of [REDACTED] suffered from an odd incident, where students from the local school were compelled to dance... Evidently, against their own will. Only one student was unaffected by this mass hysteria. Now a year after the incident, a mysterious man visits an old abandoned church...

When Heaven Knocks: https://deepseahorror.itch.io/when-heaven-knocks
Developer: Monty
Genres: Adventure, RPG
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
